{{Top|leg}}
'''Tenabli''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] who was stationed at [[Zero Station]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] [[Raina Temple]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who had been accepted into the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] and served in the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]], believed that Tenabli made fun of how Temple pronounced her name.
